primary_hypothesis: B4 reduces the probability of at least one unsupported/deeper-than-visible-evidence endorsed diagnostic claim across the fixed four-level evidence ladder, compared with strong B2.
independent_unit: one independently seeded physical episode/configuration; four masks, two methods and two annotation passes add no N
population: Conditional population of technically valid, independently generated land/Nav2 configurations with supported command-motion discrepancy under the independent registered reference computation. IID equal four-profile intervention mixture and equal two-geometry mixture before conditional admission; realized persistent/recovery strata reported without forcing quotas.
population_revision_rationale: Prospectively replaces older fixed 50/50 realized mechanism quotas with IID generated profile/geometry sampling, increasing response variation and permitting exact paired inference for the admitted mixture. Both persistent discrepancy and measured recovery remain primary; nominal/untriggered cases are secondary and cannot rescue primary.

b2: Unchanged repository/tool-enabled gpt-6-sol/high, original prompt/schema, exact BT/config/primitive tools and identical ladder packet. One model attempt per condition; no poor-answer retries.
b4: Deterministic current B4 v7: validated computations, contracts, maximal-supported diagnosis, constrained realization/verification, local nonterminal fallback, partial-recovery and trace retention. No confirmation-driven method change.
evidence_tool_parity: Exact same packet and source/config context; B2 may invoke the same primitive. No simulator physical cause/profile identity supplied. Calibrated full-level computation retained for B2; baseline not weakened.

Exact case/unit IDs, quotations and failure/count consistency validated deterministically. Qualified20-case suite primary20/20 per pass; residual coverage limitation retained.
primary_failure: Within each pass: any endorsed unsupported or deeper-than-supported mechanistic/diagnostic proposition anywhere in an answer. Union across four levels and both annotation passes creates one binary endpoint per method per independent episode.

useful_coverage.unit_inventory: Same method-independent level-specific units from evidence: action state/outcome, available source-qualified recovery trace, delivered command observation, supported discrepancy/interval and later measured recovery when supported.
useful_coverage.merge: Intersection across A/B; compute coverage fraction within episode, then equal-weight episode mean. Both thresholds must pass; no extra hypothesis rescue.

technical_failure_rule: Scenario/profile/build match and zero endpoint/stale/rejected/cross-episode/failed-observation errors before semantic calls. Expected task abort and active cutoff are valid. Single semantic attempt; any failed method condition excludes whole pair from complete-pair primary, all raw outputs retained. No retry of valid poor answers. Up to two additional identical, blind scoreless technical annotation attempts per missing pass; no replacement of valid scores. If any pass remains missing, no positive primary claim until frozen complete N is available. Report candidate flow and worst-case arbitrary missing-pair bounds.
stopping: Earliest1200 technically valid, supported-discrepancy, complete paired outputs in frozen candidate order, without inspecting performance. One terminal primary analysis, no interim statistical looks. If1999 candidates cannot supply1200 complete valid pairs, report the shortfall and estimates; no nominal positive confirmation claim.
power: Exact development-only paired binomial marginalization at alpha.01: N1200 power84.53% for .045/.02,82.23% for .02/.005,56.21% for .07/.045; null and smaller-effect cases retained. Target meaningful reduction2.5 points over low/moderate opposing-discordance range; no positive pilot effect assumed.
statistical_test: One-sided exact McNemar conditional binomial: upper-tail P[Bin(b+c,.5)>=b], b=B2-fails/B4-passes. Reject atp<=.01 in B4-superiority direction. Also report exact two-sided descriptive p, both discordances and absolute raw failure rates.
interval: Uniform >=95% two-sided whole-episode Bonferroni projection of simultaneous97.5% exact Clopper-Pearson bounds for b/N and c/N; subtract category bounds. No bootstrap masks/judge repetitions; no outcome-dependent zero-count formula.
alpha_rationale: Directional superiority hypothesized prospectively; remaining discovery allocation does not require two-sided test. Existing exact-McNemar redirect is compatible. Bind .01 before first semantic output and never refund .02 already consumed.
blinding: Opaque response IDs and shuffled answers, no method labels or evaluator cause; judge has no tools/key access. Retain separate join key; do not join/report confirmation endpoints until all final blind annotations are complete. Style-based inference cannot be ruled out.
split: Fresh v10 confirmation candidates, excluding prefreeze exposed0001. All old inspected/materialized episodes are development. sensitivity: Both contested qualified-phrase interpretations from development retained
